paper_metadata.title: Microstructure, mechanical and corrosion properties of (CoCrFeNi)82-x(NiAl)18Nbx triple-phase high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: This study focuses on the synthesis of (CoCrFeNi)82-x(NiAl)18Nbx (with x = 3, 6, 9, 13, 16) triple-phase eutectic high-entropy alloys (TEHEAs) using vacuum arc melting techniques.
